templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
templates.description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, jurisdiction) and signatures. Incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard Terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA, governing how two parties disclose, use and protect each other's confidential information.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for selling or buying a SaaS / cloud service, covering access and use, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper service level terms supplementing a cloud service agreement with target uptime, response times, and service credits for missed commitments.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper terms governing how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, addressing processor/subprocessor roles, security, data subject requests, breaches and international transfers (e.g. GDPR).

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper terms for giving an early design partner access to a pre-release product in exchange for feedback and participation in product development.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper terms for engaging a provider to perform services and deliverables under one or more Statements of Work (SOWs).

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, payments, trademark use, confidentiality and liability.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper terms for a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, governing how a provider uses, discloses and safeguards protected health information (PHI).

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper terms for licensing installable / on-premise software to a customer, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper terms for a limited-time pilot or trial that lets a prospective customer evaluate a product before committing to a full purchase.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper addendum that supplements an existing agreement with terms for AI services, addressing input, output, model training and related restrictions.
